stories.title: Explainability Mapping Engine Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic that maps raw evaluation signals from provider_detail_service and clinical_trials_service into standardized explainability objects (source, meaning, limitations). Include rule-based transformations for credential status, external links, and trial metadata.

stories.title: Explainability API and Chat Rendering Contract
stories.description: Extend Evaluate Care API responses and chat message formatting to include explainability objects in a consistent structure consumable by the frontend MessageBubble renderer, ensuring safe markdown rendering and clear separation of signal vs explanation.
